collections.title: Hidden Landscapes
collections.statement: Hidden landscapes are emotions painted with words.

works.title: Outside Forces #1 - Hidden Landscapes
works.statement: This artwork explores the invisible damage suffered by the innocent, brought about by two warring factions. Hidden landscapes are emotions painted with words. Each emotion is expressed in words by the artist then interpreted by AI. As the paint is guided across the pixels, a vignette opens up on a moment previously held beneath the surface.

works.title: Injustice on our shores #2 - Hidden Landscapes
works.statement: This artwork explores the impact of judgment on the edge of our identity and the world we explore. Hidden landscapes are emotions painted with words. works.title: Geodetica #100
works.statement: Geodetica documents the shortest visual path between human and machine. AI was invited to interpret 100 artwork titles from the Geodetic Moments collection by MintFace. Geodetic Moment: 100 of 100 Artwork Title: Never leave yourself without a moment. Take one. Share it. Can you comprehend what AI is observing anon?

collections.title: Geodetic Memory
collections.statement: A dance with the unconscious mind, after Dali.

works.title: Geodetic Memory
works.statement: Geodetic Memory interprets our desire to dance with the unconscious mind, to bring forth an idea... and shape the Web3.0 experiment in the name of art. Scenarios that might be considered bizarre or impossible 'in real life' are made possible every day in Web3.0. Geodetic Memory draws inspiration from the surrealist work of Salvador Dali, celebrating the magic and strange beauty of our human existence. - The summit was recorded by MintFace on 3rd July 2022. - The 'moon face' and 'mirror portal' were AI generated by Dall-E, and then introduced into the scene by MintFace for eventual minting and insertion into our collective memory.

works.title: City versus Nature
works.statement: Every city is expanding yet so is nature with every heartbeat. This artwork shows balance between the two in Wellington, New Zealand - the first city to prioritise birds over people with the Predator Free Wellington initiative in Zealandia. Get your copy of this popular view from the highest point at the centre of the city and display it in your home.

works.title: Geodetic Moment
works.statement: The planet is covered in Geodetic Markers, also called survey markers to mark key survey points on the Earth's surface. They are often founded at the summit of high hills, offering a contemplative moment to their visitors. This 'Geodetic Moment' is a study of our inner selves, and how a shift in perspective is all that's needed to completely change what we see. This 1/1 artwork was selected from a study of 100 Geodetic Moments minted over many months beginning during the 'JPEG Summer' of 2021. [View Geodetic Moments collection](https://opensea.io/collection/geodetic-moments) This place has become sacred for the artist to visit to stay connected to the most special people in his life. Artist: No City: No Day: Saturday Direction: Forwards Geodetic Marker: Yes People: No Sea: No Stars: No Sun: Yes Sunset: Yes Time: 8:01 PM Weather: Volcanic Look to the horizon and measure where you stand. Look forward and see what’s possible.

works.title: 10k Project
works.statement: 10k Project is a commentary on the dominance of profile pictures (pfp) as NFT culture. NFT collectors and traders are nudged by 10k project founders to swap their Twitter profile picture to spread the initial success of their project. Most 10k projects receive a flash of prominence, yet only a few make to be perceived as a blue-chip success. Less obvious, is **how many of us bond with our profile picture** beyond its trade-able value and keep it as our new Web3.0 identity. Shown in this 1/1 artwork titled ‘10k Project’ is the pure diversity on show across the many 10k projects created to date. Each square of pixels represents one of 10,000 frens who followed [@mintfaced](https://twitter.com/mintfaced) between April 2021 and April 2022 because NFTs are people. Can you see your Web3.0 identity anon? Title: 10k Project Artist: MintFace x Matthew Hirschey Resolution: 4800 x 4800 Size: 22.9Mb

works.title: 10k Phunks v3
works.statement: 10k Phunks introduces more frens to the concept of 'Phunkism'. Phunkism is about finding your voice and how you fit into this space and finding how you might contribute. Phunkism is an inspiration. Inspiring yourself and inspiring others to buidl. Go for it. Buidl your vision for a phunky Web3.0 future.

works.title: 10k Ghosted
works.statement: 10K Ghosted illustrates the ephemeral nature of community in NFTs. While 10K Project celebrated the rise of the MintFace community, 10K Ghosted commiserates those NFT frens who faded away in the crypto winter of 2022. Each black pixel represents a person who stopped tweeting in May 2022, and likely stopped creating or collecting art altogether. 🥃 Pour one out for frens no longer here. If you are still part of the 10K Project, congratulations 🎉 Artist Collab: MintFace x Matthew Hirschey

other_works.title: AInception
other_works.statement: AInception AInception explores the uncanny valley separating the real from the surreal. Will AI expand or crush our world? If we can make it through the valley, Geodetica awaits.
